notes.title: Thank you to our Alpha 2 players!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149547/9145a45b423eaed800d6d0b25b2543a944c4ce15.png"][/img][/p][p]From all of us at Uncommon, thank you for scampering into Alpha 2! We’ve been making this wholesome world of animals and mechs for a long time now and it has been wonderful bringing it to players once again.🐶😺🦝[/p][p]Over the past weeks, you’ve inspired us with your reception to Animalkind at this early stage. From players meeting in the Wilderness, making friends, and starting islands together to crowds working together to scavenge the ever-so-brittle codex fragments, we loved how much people enjoyed playing together. From awww-somely-cozy towns to absurd item stacking and terraforming, we were impressed by your creativity. From massive farming operations, non-stop fishing, and hanging out swapping stories at a campfire in the Wilderness, we appreciated all of the ways people found fun in the game. 💕[/p][p]It is safe to say that Alpha 2 was an immense success for us. We saw 10 times the number of players compared to Alpha 1 (and we wish we could have let more into the playtest). We have an amazing amount of feedback to go through. Through Alpha 2 you have left your pawprints on our story and given us so many ideas for how to improve the game. With your help we’re going to make Animalkind truly special. 🌱🏡✨[/p][p]We’ll be sharing more about what we saw and learned in Alpha 2 in the future. But for now we just wanted to thank you again for being part of our journey. 🐾[/p][p]With gratitude, [/p][p]The Uncommon Team[/p]

Whether you’ve crafted a cozy cottage town🏡, a serene nature retreat🌲, or a bustling village buzzing with activity🏢, we want to see it! Let your creativity shine and showcase how you’ve shaped your world using Animalkind’s decorating and terraforming tools - and hey, you might earn some rewards too.[/p][p][/p][p]The Uncommon team will judge your entries based on originality, creativity, use of terraforming skills, cohesion/style, and clarity of theme. notes.title: Spring Update!
notes.notes:
Hello there from Uncommon Team HQ! 

Since it’s been a little while since our last major update, we wanted to fill you in on some Animalkind news. Before we dive in though, we just wanted to say thank you for sticking with us on this journey. We’re excited to bring Animalkind to you and your support means so much to us. And now… onto the news!

[h3]Animalkind at IGN Live[/h3]

Summer is fast approaching and that is an exciting time for us, as we’re going to be making an announcement during IGN Live on June 8th. We’ll have more to say afterwards, so keep an eye out and if you can try to tune into the event. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149547/9e4f12d775aa4aecd8822d61f5925b219f252dae.png[/img]

[h3]Development Update[/h3]

While Alpha 1 was an exciting glimpse into the future of Animalkind, the truth is that there was still a lot of game to build and realizing our vision for the game has been keeping us busy. We still have a ways to go but at this point we’re happy to share some of what we’ve achieved since Alpha 1, in the form of bullet points!

Major Additions
[list]
[*] The Wilderness - players can now travel to a new part of game world, the wilderness, where they can meet other players and new NPCs.
[*] Farming and Cultivation - players can now plant and harvest a variety of crops in the game. This may be a great way to earn some treats or cook food for your friends…
[*] Customization - players now have many more customization options for their player characters and their mechs.
[*] Art (So. Much. Art!) -  there are so many new assets, animations, and effects in the game. We hope you love them as much as we do!
[/list]

Iterations and Improvements
[list]
[*] Contextual Tutorials - players can now learn about the game naturally as they progress, triggering tutorials when they run into new content or mechanics.
[*] User Interface - the UI has been a major focal point and we’re rolling out updates to many of the menus and interfaces across the game.
[*] Decoration - we’ve made the decoration system easier and more powerful, so you can more easily create the ideal town or home that you’re imagining. However, beds can no longer be used to create improbably tall towers.
[*] Terrain Modification - we’ve made modifying the game world’s terrain easier and more powerful as well (what could wrong?!).
[/list]

This is only a portion of what we’ve been able to do with the game though, and there is more we’d like to do! Stay tuned for more details and updates soon™️.

[h3]Community Update[/h3]

With our focus on the game itself and the upcoming events, we’ve been a little quiet in the Discord server but we are ready to change that. We’ve recently brought on some help to tidy things up and make sure the server is a safe, warm place to share, listen, and be heard. You may have noticed some changes to the server - that’s just part of this process. With the game progressing as well as it is, we’re looking forward to having more to share with you. 

[h3]A (Quick) Word from the Studio Head…[/h3]

[i]With Alpha 1, we wanted to share the earliest version of Animalkind that we could and learn from you and the rest of our community. We’re glad that it was well received and we learned that players are excited about where we’re taking the game. With Alpha 2, we finally have a chance to share some of what we think is most special about Animalkind: Delightful, cooperative multiplayer. Playing together is a cornerstone for our game studio philosophy and we are excited about what we’re cooking up for this build![/i]
-Steven

On behalf of the Uncommon Games team, thank you for being part of the Animalkind community and taking an interest in our game. It means a lot to us!

notes.title: What to Expect From Our First Animalkind Alpha Playtest
notes.notes:
Welcome back to another blogtastic… well, blog! We’re making a game and that game is called [i]Animalkind[/i]. In case you missed our first blog post from earlier this month, we’ve got a closed Alpha playtest coming up that many of you signed up for over on Steam and we’re so close to getting some adorable corgis in mech suits into your hands. Before you venture out into the Wild and start getting your craft on, we wanted to share a little more detail to set some expectations regarding the upcoming Alpha and what will - and what will not - be available.

We show a lot of stuff we’re experimenting with for [i]Animalkind [/i]on our socials with our videos, but we wanted to be clear that some of what you may have seen will not be seen in the upcoming Alpha. This first Alpha is about getting you familiar with your home island and the world of [i]Animalkind [/i]for the first time. It’s also about giving a taste of the creative ways you can enjoy this experience solo or with friends and getting a general idea of the various town-building and world-editing tools within the game.  But… more on that later. For now, here’s what you can expect from Alpha 1.

To read the FULL blog post, you can check that out [url=https://www.animalkind.gg/post/what-to-expect-from-our-first-animalkind-alpha-playtest]right here[/url]!

notes.title: Welcome to Animalkind, A New Creative Adventure From Uncommon Games
notes.notes:
Corgis. Mech suits. CORGIS IN MECH SUITS. (and other adorable animals, of course)

Welcome to our first official blog post here at Uncommon Games where we wanted to formally welcome you into the Animalkind community! You may be asking yourself, “Self, what is Uncommon Games and Animalkind?” What a brilliant question, fellow indie connoisseur, let’s dive in.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FKgqctYznoQ

Create, explore, and become a part of the cozy world of Animalkind; a whimsical online gaming experience where you can choose from an array of characters to don a spiffy mech suit and dive into a new world ready to be explored and creativity conquered. This will be an ongoing gameplay experience, so the game will grow alongside the community to further push the boundaries of what creative crafting can look like if you could have your dream customizable island. We have quite a few folks obsessed with games like Skyrim and Dragon Age on our small team, so fully expect some recreations of our own favorite gaming adventures getting shoved in your faces on our social channels. And who knows? Maybe that will inspire you to wholesomely craft your own dream crossover.

[url=https://www.animalkind.gg/post/animalkind-indie-game-creative-building-multiplayer style=button]Read the full post on our blog at Animalkind.gg![/url]
